description: Source code for a documentation processing module, including classes for Documentation, Class, Member, and Type, with functions for parsing types, processing code groups, and managing links in documentation nodes.

classes.name: Documentation
classes.description: Manages a collection of classes, supports merging, filtering by language, link rendering, and source code comment generation.

classes.name: Class
classes.description: Represents a class with members, properties, methods, and inheritance handling.

classes.name: Member
classes.description: Represents a class member such as method, property, or event, with filtering, cloning, and visiting capabilities.

classes.name: Type
classes.description: Represents a data type with parsing, cloning, and filtering functionalities.

methods.name: mergeWith
methods.description: Merges current documentation with another, returning a new Documentation instance.

methods.name: copyDocsFromSuperclasses
methods.description: Copies documentation from superclasses, appending members and checking for errors.

methods.name: filterForLanguage
methods.description: Filters classes and members based on specified language and options.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Indexes classes and their members for quick lookup.

methods.name: setLinkRenderer
methods.description: Sets a custom link renderer and patches links in documentation nodes.

methods.name: renderLinksInNodes
methods.description: Replaces link placeholders in documentation nodes with actual links.

methods.name: renderLinksInText
methods.description: Replaces link placeholders in text with actual links.

methods.name: setCodeGroupsTransformer
methods.description: Sets a transformer for code groups in documentation.

methods.name: generateSourceCodeComments
methods.description: Generates source code comments for all classes and members.

methods.name: clone
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the Documentation instance.
